title: platanthera major
intro: Platanthera major, commonly known as the greater purple orchid, is a perennial orchid species native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Platanthera major include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Platanthera major, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties, which may also have potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic effects.
